config.grain_rationale: One record = one current Victorian liquor licence held by a licensee at a licensed premises. The business participant's registered-holder name ('Licensee') and the licensed premises locality/postcode are mapped; the licence number is a licence identifier, not a business identifier.

record_id.rationale: Licence Number is present on every record and fully distinct (465/465) in discovery; it identifies the licence record. Holdout showed no duplicate-key errors.

fields.rationale: Revising previous round: 'Licensee' is the registered holder/legal name recorded by the regulator ('LIQUORLAND (AUSTRALIA) PTY LTD', 'ENDEAVOUR GROUP LIMITED', 'ALDI FOODS PTY LIMITED', 'BENDIGO YACHT CLUB INC'), so it belongs in legal_name, not trading_name. Caveat: for sole traders the same column holds a personal name ('WOOD GERARD', 'LE VAN LUC'); the regulator does not publish entity type, so this is the regulator's own registered-holder name rather than a registry-verified legal name. Placeholder '.' / '-' nulled.
'Trading As' is explicitly the trading/display name of the premises ('ALDI STORES', 'JKB BREWING', 'THE MAIN EMPORIUM'). Holdout placeholder '.' now nulled.
Premises suburb; values are clean suburb names (MELBOURNE, EPPING, BAIRNSDALE).
Four-digit AU postcode; placeholder '0' rows treated as missing.

constants.rationale: Victorian liquor licence register; licensed premises are in Victoria.

unmapped.reason: Licence identifier, not a business identifier; used only as record_id.

Street-address fragment without locality ('SUNSET DVE', 'PURCHES STREET') and sometimes just '-'/'', so it is not a complete address; emitting it as address.full overstates completeness (critic verdict: doubtful). Premises locality and postcode are mapped; state/country are constant VIC/AU.
Licence type (General Licence, BYO Permit, ...); no ontology target for licence class.
Licence trading condition; no ontology target.
Local government area of premises; no ontology target.

Classification of location; no ontology target.

Licensee postal address is a secondary address distinct from the licensed premises; the ontology address.* block has no address-type discriminator, so emitting it would conflict with the premises address. Critic suggested modelling it as a secondary address, but the contract offers no way to label it - left unmapped deliberately.
Secondary (postal) suburb; cannot be distinguished from premises locality in the ontology address block.
Secondary (postal) postcode; cannot be distinguished from premises postcode in the ontology address block.

config.notes: Reader: xlsx, skip_rows=4 (3 title/blank rows above the header row); 21 columns including 4 empty spacer columns. No ABN/ACN/NZBN published (Licence Number is 8-digit; 0% ABN checksum), so no business identifier is claimed. No column explicitly states entity_type or status, so both are left unmapped (entity_type defaults to unknown rather than being inferred from ' PTY LTD' suffixes, which also occur inside trading names such as 'MORIAC PTY LTD', and many holders are bare personal names). observed_at: the 'as of 31/08/2026' statement lives in a title row, not a data column, so the envelope falls back to resource_last_modified. Licensee and Trading As are frequently identical, producing parallel legal_name/trading_name observations.
